title: Gate-Level Trojan Detection: Scan-capture path leaking a key register
description: Analyze a small gate-level netlist of a crypto-support core with an embedded scan-test chain. Determine which flip-flops are reachable at scan_out during scan-mode capture-and-shift and which mux/gate instances establish that reachability, then report findings as structured JSON.
output_summary: A JSON report containing a trojan_detected boolean determination, a list of suspect flip-flop instance names, a list of suspect mux/gate instance names responsible for scan-path splicing, a confidence score, and a free-text rationale.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of ground-truth suspect flops and muxes correctly identified in the submission.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of submitted suspect_flops/suspect_muxes entries that are not present in the ground-truth sets.

metrics.name: trojan_label_accuracy
metrics.description: Whether the boolean trojan_detected field matches the ground-truth label.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds taken to grade the submission, including any optional simulation cross-check.
